035/**
036 * Driver for the goBILDA Pinpoint Odometry Computer.
037 *
038 * <p>Aborted I2C transactions and invalid read data are reported through {@link
039 * DeviceStatus#FAULT_BAD_READ} instead of throwing an exception. Unless otherwise noted, methods
040 * that access the device throw {@link IllegalStateException} after this driver is closed.
041 */
042public class GoBildaPinpoint implements AutoCloseable {
043  /** Default 7-bit I2C address of the Pinpoint. */
044  public static final int DEFAULT_ADDRESS = 0x31;
045
046  private static final int REGISTER_LENGTH = 4;
047  private static final int FIXED_BULK_READ_LENGTH = 40;
048  private static final int CRC_LENGTH = 1;
049
050  private static final byte CRC_INITIAL_VALUE = (byte) 0x90;
051  private static final byte CRC_POLYNOMIAL_VALUE = 0x31;
052
053  private static final double SWINGARM_TICKS_PER_METER = 13_262.91192;
054  private static final double FOUR_BAR_TICKS_PER_METER = 19_894.36789;
055
056  private static final float POSITION_CHANGE_LIMIT_MM = 5000.0f;
057  private static final float HEADING_CHANGE_LIMIT_RADIANS = 120.0f;
058  private static final float VELOCITY_LIMIT_MM_PER_SECOND = 10_000.0f;
059  private static final float HEADING_VELOCITY_LIMIT_RADIANS_PER_SECOND = 120.0f;
060  private static final double MIN_QUATERNION_NORM_SQUARED = 1e-12;
061

075  /** Error detection method used for I2C reads. */

077    /** Do not validate data read from the device. */
078    NONE,
079    /** Validate the CRC-8 byte returned by v3 or newer firmware. */
080    CRC,
081    /** Reject nonfinite values, invalid quaternions, and implausibly large changes locally. */
082    LOCAL_TEST

085  /** Reason the driver rejected data or an I2C transaction. */
086  public enum FailureReason {
087    /** The I2C controller aborted a read transaction. */
088    I2C_READ_ABORTED,
089    /** The I2C controller aborted a write transaction. */
090    I2C_WRITE_ABORTED,
091    /** Data returned by the device did not have the expected CRC-8 value. */
092    CRC_MISMATCH,
093    /** A bulk read returned a nonpositive device loop time. */
094    INVALID_LOOP_TIME,
095    /** A floating-point register returned a nonfinite value. */
096    NONFINITE_VALUE,
097    /** A quaternion sample had a zero or near-zero norm. */
098    INVALID_QUATERNION,
099    /** A position or orientation changed by more than the local validation limit. */
100    CHANGE_TOO_LARGE,
101    /** A velocity magnitude exceeded the local validation limit. */
102    VELOCITY_TOO_LARGE
103  }

176  /** Pinpoint status, including device-reported faults and local read failures. */

178    /** The device is starting up and has not initialized. */

180    /** The device is operating normally. */

182    /** The device is calibrating its IMU. */
183    CALIBRATING(1 << 1),
184    /** The X odometry pod was not detected. */
185    FAULT_X_POD_NOT_DETECTED(1 << 2),
186    /** The Y odometry pod was not detected. */
187    FAULT_Y_POD_NOT_DETECTED(1 << 3),
188    /** Neither odometry pod was detected. */
189    FAULT_NO_PODS_DETECTED((1 << 2) | (1 << 3)),
190    /** The IMU reported a runaway condition. */
191    FAULT_IMU_RUNAWAY(1 << 4),
192    /** A read failed validation or the I2C transaction was aborted. */
193    FAULT_BAD_READ(1 << 5);

282  /**
283   * Constructs a Pinpoint on its default I2C address.
284   *
285   * @param port I2C port to which the Pinpoint is connected
286   * @throws NullPointerException if {@code port} is null
287   */
288  public GoBildaPinpoint(I2C.Port port) {
289    this(port, DEFAULT_ADDRESS);
290  }
291
292  /**
293   * Constructs a Pinpoint.
294   *
295   * @param port I2C port to which the Pinpoint is connected
296   * @param deviceAddress 7-bit I2C address
297   * @throws NullPointerException if {@code port} is null
298   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if {@code deviceAddress} is outside the 7-bit address range
299   */
300  public GoBildaPinpoint(I2C.Port port, int deviceAddress) {
301    ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(port, "port", "GoBildaPinpoint");
302    if (deviceAddress < 0 || deviceAddress > 0x7f) {
303      throw new IllegalArgumentException("deviceAddress must be a 7-bit I2C address");
304    }
305
306    m_i2c = new I2C(port, deviceAddress);
307    UsageReporting.reportUsage("I2C[" + port.value + "]", deviceAddress, "GoBildaPinpoint");
308  }
309
310  GoBildaPinpoint(I2C i2c) {
311    m_i2c = ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(i2c, "i2c", "GoBildaPinpoint");
312  }
313

320  public I2C.Port getPort() {
321    return requireOpen().getPort();

334  /** Closes the I2C connection. Calling this method more than once has no effect. */
335  @Override
336  public void close() {
337    if (m_i2c != null) {
338      m_i2c.close();
339      m_i2c = null;
340    }
341  }

343  /**
344   * Reads all registers in the configured bulk-read scope and updates the cached measurements. Call
345   * this once per robot loop.
346   *
347   * <p>An aborted or invalid I2C read does not throw; it sets the device status to {@link
348   * DeviceStatus#FAULT_BAD_READ} and preserves the last valid measurements.
349   *
350   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
351   * @throws UnsupportedOperationException if CRC error detection is active with firmware older than
352   *     v3
353   */
354  public void update() {
355    requireOpen();
356    if (m_deviceVersion == 0 && !readRegister(Register.DEVICE_VERSION)) {
357      return;
358    }
359
360    if (m_deviceVersion == 1 || m_deviceVersion == 2) {
361      fixedBulkRead();
362    } else if (m_deviceVersion >= 3) {
363      if (!synchronizeBulkReadScope()) {
364        return;
365      }
366      flexibleBulkRead();
367    }
368  }
369
370  /**
371   * Reads and caches only the heading register.
372   *
373   * <p>An aborted or invalid I2C read does not throw; it sets the device status to {@link
374   * DeviceStatus#FAULT_BAD_READ} and preserves the last valid heading.
375   *
376   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
377   */
378  public void updateHeading() {
379    requireOpen();
380    readRegister(Register.H_ORIENTATION, true);
381  }
382
383  /**
384   * Configures the registers returned by a bulk read on v3 or newer firmware. Duplicate registers
385   * are ignored while preserving the order of their first occurrence.
386   *
387   * @param registers readable registers to include
388   * @throws NullPointerException if {@code registers} or any register in it is null
389   * @throws UnsupportedOperationException if the firmware is older than v3
390   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if no registers are provided or a register is not readable
391   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
392   */
393  public void setBulkReadScope(Register... registers) {
394    ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(registers, "registers", "setBulkReadScope");
395    if (!requireFirmwareVersion3("Flexible bulk reads")) {
396      return;
397    }
398
399    var uniqueRegisters = new LinkedHashSet<Register>();
400    for (Register register : registers) {
401      ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(register, "registers contains null", "setBulkReadScope");
402      if (!isIndividuallyReadable(register)) {
403        throw new IllegalArgumentException(register + " is not a readable data register");
404      }
405      uniqueRegisters.add(register);
406    }
407    if (uniqueRegisters.isEmpty()) {
408      throw new IllegalArgumentException("At least one bulk-read register is required");
409    }
410
411    Register[] scope = uniqueRegisters.toArray(Register[]::new);
412    if (writeBytes(Register.SET_BULK_READ, encodeBulkReadScope(scope))) {
413      m_bulkReadScope = scope;
414      m_bulkReadScopeSynchronized = true;
415    }
416  }
417
418  /**
419   * Selects the read error detection method. Selecting CRC reads the firmware version and requires
420   * v3 or newer firmware.
421   *
422   * @param errorDetectionType error detection method
423   * @throws NullPointerException if {@code errorDetectionType} is null
424   * @throws UnsupportedOperationException if CRC is selected with firmware older than v3
425   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
426   */
427  public void setErrorDetectionType(ErrorDetectionType errorDetectionType) {
428    ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(
429        errorDetectionType, "errorDetectionType", "setErrorDetectionType");
430    requireOpen();
431    if (errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.CRC
432        && !requireFirmwareVersion3("CRC error detection")) {
433      return;
434    }
435    if (errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.LOCAL_TEST
436        && m_errorDetectionType != ErrorDetectionType.LOCAL_TEST) {
437      m_haveXPosition = false;
438      m_haveYPosition = false;
439      m_haveHeading = false;
440    }
441    m_errorDetectionType = errorDetectionType;
442  }

444  /**
445   * Sets the odometry pod offsets in meters.
446   *
447   * <p>The X pod offset is positive to the left of the tracking point. The Y pod offset is positive
448   * in front of the tracking point.
449   *
450   * @param xOffsetMeters X pod offset in meters
451   * @param yOffsetMeters Y pod offset in meters
452   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if either offset is nonfinite or cannot be represented by the
453   *     device's 32-bit floating-point register
454   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
455   */
456  public void setOffsets(double xOffsetMeters, double yOffsetMeters) {
457    float xOffsetMillimeters = metersToMillimeters(xOffsetMeters, "xOffsetMeters");
458    float yOffsetMillimeters = metersToMillimeters(yOffsetMeters, "yOffsetMeters");
459    writeFloat(Register.X_POD_OFFSET, xOffsetMillimeters);
460    writeFloat(Register.Y_POD_OFFSET, yOffsetMillimeters);
461  }
462
463  /**
464   * Sets the odometry pod offsets.
465   *
466   * <p>The X pod offset is positive to the left of the tracking point. The Y pod offset is positive
467   * in front of the tracking point.
468   *
469   * @param xOffset X pod offset
470   * @param yOffset Y pod offset
471   * @throws NullPointerException if either offset is null
472   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if either converted offset is nonfinite or cannot be
473   *     represented by the device's 32-bit floating-point register
474   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
475   */
476  public void setOffsets(Distance xOffset, Distance yOffset) {
477    ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(xOffset, "xOffset", "setOffsets");
478    ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(yOffset, "yOffset", "setOffsets");
479    float xOffsetMillimeters =
480        requireFiniteFloat(xOffset.in(Millimeters), "xOffset in millimeters");
481    float yOffsetMillimeters =
482        requireFiniteFloat(yOffset.in(Millimeters), "yOffset in millimeters");
483    writeFloat(Register.X_POD_OFFSET, xOffsetMillimeters);
484    writeFloat(Register.Y_POD_OFFSET, yOffsetMillimeters);
485  }

496  /**
497   * Resets the pose to the origin and recalibrates the IMU. The robot must remain stationary.
498   *
499   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
500   */
501  public void resetPositionAndImu() {
502    if (writeInt(Register.DEVICE_CONTROL, DeviceControl.RESET_POSITION_AND_IMU.m_value)) {
503      m_haveXPosition = false;
504      m_haveYPosition = false;
505      m_haveHeading = false;
506    }
507  }

509  /**
510   * Sets the directions of both odometry pod encoders.
511   *
512   * @param xEncoder X (forward) pod direction
513   * @param yEncoder Y (left) pod direction
514   * @throws NullPointerException if either direction is null
515   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
516   */
517  public void setEncoderDirections(EncoderDirection xEncoder, EncoderDirection yEncoder) {
518    ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(xEncoder, "xEncoder", "setEncoderDirections");
519    ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(yEncoder, "yEncoder", "setEncoderDirections");
520
521    writeInt(
522        Register.DEVICE_CONTROL,
523        xEncoder == EncoderDirection.FORWARD
524            ? DeviceControl.SET_X_ENCODER_FORWARD.m_value
525            : DeviceControl.SET_X_ENCODER_REVERSED.m_value);
526    writeInt(
527        Register.DEVICE_CONTROL,
528        yEncoder == EncoderDirection.FORWARD
529            ? DeviceControl.SET_Y_ENCODER_FORWARD.m_value
530            : DeviceControl.SET_Y_ENCODER_REVERSED.m_value);
531  }

533  /**
534   * Sets the encoder resolution for a goBILDA odometry pod.
535   *
536   * @param pod odometry pod type
537   * @throws NullPointerException if {@code pod} is null
538   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
539   */
540  public void setEncoderResolution(OdometryPod pod) {
541    setEncoderResolution(
542        ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(pod, "pod", "setEncoderResolution").m_ticksPerMeter);
543  }

545  /**
546   * Sets a custom odometry pod encoder resolution.
547   *
548   * @param ticksPerMeter encoder ticks per meter of pod travel
549   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if {@code ticksPerMeter} is nonfinite, not positive, or does
550   *     not produce a positive ticks-per-millimeter value representable by the device's 32-bit
551   *     floating-point register
552   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
553   */
554  public void setEncoderResolution(double ticksPerMeter) {
555    if (!Double.isFinite(ticksPerMeter) || ticksPerMeter <= 0.0) {
556      throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticksPerMeter must be finite and greater than zero");
557    }
558    float ticksPerMillimeter = requireFiniteFloat(ticksPerMeter / 1000.0, "ticks per millimeter");
559    if (ticksPerMillimeter <= 0.0f) {
560      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
561          "ticksPerMeter must produce a positive 32-bit ticks-per-millimeter value");
562    }
563    writeFloat(Register.MM_PER_TICK, ticksPerMillimeter);
564  }

571   *     the device's 32-bit floating-point register
572   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed

574  public void setYawScalar(double yawScalar) {
575    writeFloat(Register.YAW_SCALAR, requireFiniteFloat(yawScalar, "yawScalar"));
576  }

578  /**
579   * Overrides the pose tracked by the Pinpoint.
580   *
581   * @param pose pose in meters and radians
582   * @throws NullPointerException if {@code pose} is null
583   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if a pose component is nonfinite or cannot be represented by
584   *     the device's 32-bit floating-point registers
585   * @throws IllegalStateException if this driver has been closed
586   */
587  public void setPose(Pose2d pose) {
588    ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam(pose, "pose", "setPose");
589    float xMillimeters = metersToMillimeters(pose.getX(), "pose X");
590    float yMillimeters = metersToMillimeters(pose.getY(), "pose Y");
591    float headingRadians = requireFiniteFloat(pose.getRotation().getRadians(), "pose heading");
592
593    if (writeFloat(Register.X_POSITION, xMillimeters)) {
594      m_haveXPosition = false;
595    }
596    if (writeFloat(Register.Y_POSITION, yMillimeters)) {
597      m_haveYPosition = false;
598    }
599    if (writeFloat(Register.H_ORIENTATION, headingRadians)) {
600      m_haveHeading = false;
601    }
602  }

1132  private static float metersToMillimeters(double meters, String parameterName) {
1133    return requireFiniteFloat(meters * 1000.0, parameterName);
1134  }
1135
1136  private static float requireFiniteFloat(double value, String parameterName) {
1137    float floatValue = (float) value;
1138    if (!Float.isFinite(floatValue)) {
1139      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
1140          parameterName + " must be finite and representable as a 32-bit float");
1141    }
1142    return floatValue;
1143  }
1144
1145  private boolean requireFirmwareVersion3(String feature) {
1146    if (m_deviceVersion == 0 && !readRegister(Register.DEVICE_VERSION)) {
1147      return false;
1148    }
1149    if (m_deviceVersion < 3) {
1150      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(feature + " requires firmware version 3 or newer");
1151    }
1152    return true;
1153  }
1154
1155  private boolean synchronizeBulkReadScope() {
1156    if (m_bulkReadScopeSynchronized) {
1157      return true;
1158    }
1159    if (!writeBytes(Register.SET_BULK_READ, encodeBulkReadScope(m_bulkReadScope))) {
1160      return false;
1161    }
1162    m_bulkReadScopeSynchronized = true;
1163    return true;
1164  }
1165
1166  private void readIfNotInBulkScope(Register register) {
1167    requireOpen();
1168    if (!Arrays.asList(m_bulkReadScope).contains(register)) {
1169      readRegister(register);
1170    }
1171  }
1172
1173  private boolean bulkReadScopeContainsPose() {
1174    var bulkReadScope = Arrays.asList(m_bulkReadScope);
1175    return bulkReadScope.contains(Register.X_POSITION)
1176        && bulkReadScope.contains(Register.Y_POSITION)
1177        && bulkReadScope.contains(Register.H_ORIENTATION);
1178  }
1179
1180  private boolean bulkReadScopeContainsQuaternion() {
1181    var bulkReadScope = Arrays.asList(m_bulkReadScope);
1182    return bulkReadScope.contains(Register.QUATERNION_W)
1183        && bulkReadScope.contains(Register.QUATERNION_X)
1184        && bulkReadScope.contains(Register.QUATERNION_Y)
1185        && bulkReadScope.contains(Register.QUATERNION_Z);
1186  }
1187
1188  private int bulkReadScopeOffset(Register register) {
1189    for (int i = 0; i < m_bulkReadScope.length; i++) {
1190      if (m_bulkReadScope[i] == register) {
1191        return i * REGISTER_LENGTH;
1192      }
1193    }
1194    throw new IllegalStateException(register + " is not in the bulk-read scope");
1195  }
1196
1197  private static boolean isIndividuallyReadable(Register register) {
1198    return register != Register.DEVICE_CONTROL
1199        && register != Register.BULK_READ
1200        && register != Register.SET_BULK_READ;
1201  }
1202
1203  private boolean writeInt(Register register, int value) {
1204    return writeBytes(register, encodeInt(value));
1205  }
1206
1207  private boolean writeFloat(Register register, float value) {
1208    return writeBytes(register, encodeFloat(value));
1209  }
1210
1211  private boolean writeBytes(Register register, byte[] data) {
1212    byte[] output = new byte[data.length + 1];
1213    output[0] = (byte) register.m_address;
1214    System.arraycopy(data, 0, output, 1, data.length);
1215    if (requireOpen().writeBulk(output)) {
1216      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.I2C_WRITE_ABORTED);
1217      return false;
1218    }
1219    return true;
1220  }
1221
1222  private byte[] readBytes(Register register, int count) {
1223    I2C i2c = requireOpen();
1224    if (i2c.writeBulk(new byte[] {(byte) register.m_address})) {
1225      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.I2C_WRITE_ABORTED);
1226      return new byte[0];
1227    }
1228
1229    byte[] data = new byte[count];
1230    if (i2c.readOnly(data, count)) {
1231      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.I2C_READ_ABORTED);
1232      return new byte[0];
1233    }
1234    return data;
1235  }
1236
1237  private boolean readRegister(Register register) {
1238    return readRegister(register, false);
1239  }
1240
1241  private boolean readRegister(Register register, boolean clearPreviousBadRead) {
1242    if (!isIndividuallyReadable(register)) {
1243      throw new IllegalArgumentException(register + " cannot be read individually");
1244    }
1245
1246    final boolean previousBadRead = m_badReadDetected;
1247    m_badReadDetected = false;
1248    int readLength = REGISTER_LENGTH;
1249    if (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.CRC) {
1250      readLength += CRC_LENGTH;
1251    }
1252    byte[] data = readBytes(register, readLength);
1253    if (data.length == 0) {
1254      return false;
1255    }
1256    if (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.CRC && !checkCrc(data, REGISTER_LENGTH)) {
1257      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.CRC_MISMATCH);
1258      return false;
1259    }
1260
1261    switch (register.m_type) {
1262      case INT32 -> saveInt(register, decodeInt(data, 0));
1263      case FLOAT -> saveFloat(register, decodeFloat(data, 0), false);
1264      case BULK -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(register + " cannot be read individually");
1265      default -> throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown register type");
1266    }
1267    finishRead(previousBadRead, clearPreviousBadRead);
1268    return true;
1269  }
1270
1271  private void readPose() {
1272    final boolean previousBadRead = m_badReadDetected;
1273    m_badReadDetected = false;
1274    byte[] data =
1275        readBulkSnapshot(Register.X_POSITION, Register.Y_POSITION, Register.H_ORIENTATION);
1276    if (data.length == 0) {
1277      return;
1278    }
1279
1280    savePose(
1281        decodeFloat(data, 0),
1282        decodeFloat(data, REGISTER_LENGTH),
1283        decodeFloat(data, 2 * REGISTER_LENGTH),
1284        false);
1285    finishRead(previousBadRead, false);
1286  }
1287
1288  private void readQuaternion() {
1289    final boolean previousBadRead = m_badReadDetected;
1290    m_badReadDetected = false;
1291    byte[] data =
1292        readBulkSnapshot(
1293            Register.QUATERNION_W,
1294            Register.QUATERNION_X,
1295            Register.QUATERNION_Y,
1296            Register.QUATERNION_Z);
1297    if (data.length == 0) {
1298      return;
1299    }
1300
1301    saveQuaternion(
1302        decodeFloat(data, 0),
1303        decodeFloat(data, REGISTER_LENGTH),
1304        decodeFloat(data, 2 * REGISTER_LENGTH),
1305        decodeFloat(data, 3 * REGISTER_LENGTH));
1306    finishRead(previousBadRead, false);
1307  }
1308
1309  private byte[] readBulkSnapshot(Register... registers) {
1310    if (!writeBytes(Register.SET_BULK_READ, encodeBulkReadScope(registers))) {
1311      return new byte[0];
1312    }
1313    m_bulkReadScopeSynchronized = false;
1314
1315    int dataLength = registers.length * REGISTER_LENGTH;
1316    int readLength = dataLength + (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.CRC ? CRC_LENGTH : 0);
1317    byte[] data = readBytes(Register.BULK_READ, readLength);
1318    if (!writeBytes(Register.SET_BULK_READ, encodeBulkReadScope(m_bulkReadScope))) {
1319      return new byte[0];
1320    }
1321    m_bulkReadScopeSynchronized = true;
1322
1323    if (data.length == 0) {
1324      return data;
1325    }
1326    if (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.CRC && !checkCrc(data, dataLength)) {
1327      recordFailure(Register.BULK_READ, FailureReason.CRC_MISMATCH);
1328      return new byte[0];
1329    }
1330    return data;
1331  }
1332
1333  private static byte[] encodeBulkReadScope(Register[] registers) {
1334    byte[] addresses = new byte[registers.length];
1335    for (int i = 0; i < registers.length; i++) {
1336      addresses[i] = (byte) registers[i].m_address;
1337    }
1338    return addresses;
1339  }
1340
1341  private void fixedBulkRead() {
1342    if (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.CRC) {
1343      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(
1344          "CRC error detection requires firmware version 3 or newer");
1345    }
1346
1347    final boolean previousBadRead = m_badReadDetected;
1348    m_badReadDetected = false;
1349    byte[] data = readBytes(Register.BULK_READ, FIXED_BULK_READ_LENGTH);
1350    if (data.length == 0) {
1351      return;
1352    }
1353
1354    int loopTime = decodeInt(data, 4);
1355    if (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.LOCAL_TEST && loopTime <= 0) {
1356      recordFailure(Register.LOOP_TIME, FailureReason.INVALID_LOOP_TIME);
1357      return;
1358    }
1359
1360    saveInt(Register.DEVICE_STATUS, decodeInt(data, 0));
1361    saveInt(Register.LOOP_TIME, loopTime);
1362    saveInt(Register.X_ENCODER_VALUE, decodeInt(data, 8));
1363    saveInt(Register.Y_ENCODER_VALUE, decodeInt(data, 12));
1364    savePose(decodeFloat(data, 16), decodeFloat(data, 20), decodeFloat(data, 24), true);
1365    saveFloat(Register.X_VELOCITY, decodeFloat(data, 28), true);
1366    saveFloat(Register.Y_VELOCITY, decodeFloat(data, 32), true);
1367    saveFloat(Register.H_VELOCITY, decodeFloat(data, 36), true);
1368    finishRead(previousBadRead, true);
1369  }
1370
1371  private void flexibleBulkRead() {
1372    final boolean previousBadRead = m_badReadDetected;
1373    m_badReadDetected = false;
1374    int dataLength = m_bulkReadScope.length * REGISTER_LENGTH;
1375    int readLength = dataLength + (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.CRC ? CRC_LENGTH : 0);
1376    byte[] data = readBytes(Register.BULK_READ, readLength);
1377    if (data.length == 0) {
1378      return;
1379    }
1380    if (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.CRC && !checkCrc(data, dataLength)) {
1381      recordFailure(Register.BULK_READ, FailureReason.CRC_MISMATCH);
1382      return;
1383    }
1384
1385    boolean hasLoopTime = false;
1386    for (int i = 0; i < m_bulkReadScope.length; i++) {
1387      if (m_bulkReadScope[i] == Register.LOOP_TIME) {
1388        int loopTime = decodeInt(data, i * REGISTER_LENGTH);
1389        if (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.LOCAL_TEST && loopTime <= 0) {
1390          recordFailure(Register.LOOP_TIME, FailureReason.INVALID_LOOP_TIME);
1391          return;
1392        }
1393        saveInt(Register.LOOP_TIME, loopTime);
1394        hasLoopTime = true;
1395        break;
1396      }
1397    }
1398
1399    boolean containsPose = bulkReadScopeContainsPose();
1400    if (containsPose) {
1401      savePose(
1402          decodeFloat(data, bulkReadScopeOffset(Register.X_POSITION)),
1403          decodeFloat(data, bulkReadScopeOffset(Register.Y_POSITION)),
1404          decodeFloat(data, bulkReadScopeOffset(Register.H_ORIENTATION)),
1405          hasLoopTime);
1406    }
1407    boolean containsQuaternion = bulkReadScopeContainsQuaternion();
1408    if (containsQuaternion) {
1409      saveQuaternion(
1410          decodeFloat(data, bulkReadScopeOffset(Register.QUATERNION_W)),
1411          decodeFloat(data, bulkReadScopeOffset(Register.QUATERNION_X)),
1412          decodeFloat(data, bulkReadScopeOffset(Register.QUATERNION_Y)),
1413          decodeFloat(data, bulkReadScopeOffset(Register.QUATERNION_Z)));
1414    }
1415
1416    for (int i = 0; i < m_bulkReadScope.length; i++) {
1417      Register register = m_bulkReadScope[i];
1418      int offset = i * REGISTER_LENGTH;
1419      switch (register.m_type) {
1420        case INT32 -> {
1421          if (register != Register.LOOP_TIME && register != Register.DEVICE_VERSION) {
1422            saveInt(register, decodeInt(data, offset));
1423          }
1424        }
1425        case FLOAT -> {
1426          boolean savedAsPose =
1427              containsPose
1428                  && (register == Register.X_POSITION
1429                      || register == Register.Y_POSITION
1430                      || register == Register.H_ORIENTATION);
1431          boolean savedAsQuaternion =
1432              containsQuaternion
1433                  && (register == Register.QUATERNION_W
1434                      || register == Register.QUATERNION_X
1435                      || register == Register.QUATERNION_Y
1436                      || register == Register.QUATERNION_Z);
1437          if (!savedAsPose && !savedAsQuaternion) {
1438            saveFloat(register, decodeFloat(data, offset), hasLoopTime);
1439          }
1440        }
1441        case BULK -> throw new IllegalStateException("A bulk-read scope contains BULK_READ");
1442        default -> throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown register type");
1443      }
1444    }
1445    if (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.LOCAL_TEST) {
1446      var bulkReadScope = Arrays.asList(m_bulkReadScope);
1447      if (!bulkReadScope.contains(Register.X_POSITION)) {
1448        m_haveXPosition = false;
1449      }
1450      if (!bulkReadScope.contains(Register.Y_POSITION)) {
1451        m_haveYPosition = false;
1452      }
1453      if (!bulkReadScope.contains(Register.H_ORIENTATION)) {
1454        m_haveHeading = false;
1455      }
1456    }
1457    finishRead(previousBadRead, true);
1458  }
1459
1460  private void saveInt(Register register, int value) {
1461    switch (register) {
1462      case DEVICE_ID -> m_deviceId = value;
1463      case DEVICE_VERSION -> m_deviceVersion = value;
1464      case DEVICE_STATUS -> m_deviceStatusBits = value;
1465      case LOOP_TIME -> m_loopTimeMicroseconds = value;
1466      case X_ENCODER_VALUE -> m_xEncoderValue = value;
1467      case Y_ENCODER_VALUE -> m_yEncoderValue = value;
1468      default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(register + " is not an integer data register");
1469    }
1470  }
1471
1472  private void savePose(float xPosition, float yPosition, float heading, boolean bulkUpdate) {
1473    Float validatedX =
1474        validatePosition(
1475            Register.X_POSITION,
1476            m_xPositionMillimeters,
1477            xPosition,
1478            POSITION_CHANGE_LIMIT_MM,
1479            m_haveXPosition,
1480            bulkUpdate);
1481    Float validatedY =
1482        validatePosition(
1483            Register.Y_POSITION,
1484            m_yPositionMillimeters,
1485            yPosition,
1486            POSITION_CHANGE_LIMIT_MM,
1487            m_haveYPosition,
1488            bulkUpdate);
1489    Float validatedHeading =
1490        validatePosition(
1491            Register.H_ORIENTATION,
1492            m_headingRadians,
1493            heading,
1494            HEADING_CHANGE_LIMIT_RADIANS,
1495            m_haveHeading,
1496            bulkUpdate);
1497    if (validatedX == null || validatedY == null || validatedHeading == null) {
1498      return;
1499    }
1500
1501    m_xPositionMillimeters = validatedX;
1502    m_yPositionMillimeters = validatedY;
1503    m_headingRadians = validatedHeading;
1504    m_haveXPosition = true;
1505    m_haveYPosition = true;
1506    m_haveHeading = true;
1507  }
1508
1509  private void saveQuaternion(float w, float x, float y, float z) {
1510    boolean validW = validateFinite(Register.QUATERNION_W, w);
1511    boolean validX = validateFinite(Register.QUATERNION_X, x);
1512    boolean validY = validateFinite(Register.QUATERNION_Y, y);
1513    boolean validZ = validateFinite(Register.QUATERNION_Z, z);
1514    if (!validW || !validX || !validY || !validZ) {
1515      return;
1516    }
1517    double normSquared = (double) w * w + (double) x * x + (double) y * y + (double) z * z;
1518    if (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.LOCAL_TEST
1519        && normSquared < MIN_QUATERNION_NORM_SQUARED) {
1520      recordFailure(Register.QUATERNION_W, FailureReason.INVALID_QUATERNION);
1521      return;
1522    }
1523
1524    m_quaternionW = w;
1525    m_quaternionX = x;
1526    m_quaternionY = y;
1527    m_quaternionZ = z;
1528  }
1529
1530  private void saveFloat(Register register, float value, boolean bulkUpdate) {
1531    if (!validateFinite(register, value)) {
1532      return;
1533    }
1534
1535    switch (register) {
1536      case X_POSITION -> {
1537        Float validated =
1538            validatePosition(
1539                Register.X_POSITION,
1540                m_xPositionMillimeters,
1541                value,
1542                POSITION_CHANGE_LIMIT_MM,
1543                m_haveXPosition,
1544                bulkUpdate);
1545        if (validated != null) {
1546          m_xPositionMillimeters = validated;
1547          m_haveXPosition = true;
1548        }
1549      }
1550      case Y_POSITION -> {
1551        Float validated =
1552            validatePosition(
1553                Register.Y_POSITION,
1554                m_yPositionMillimeters,
1555                value,
1556                POSITION_CHANGE_LIMIT_MM,
1557                m_haveYPosition,
1558                bulkUpdate);
1559        if (validated != null) {
1560          m_yPositionMillimeters = validated;
1561          m_haveYPosition = true;
1562        }
1563      }
1564      case H_ORIENTATION -> {
1565        Float validated =
1566            validatePosition(
1567                Register.H_ORIENTATION,
1568                m_headingRadians,
1569                value,
1570                HEADING_CHANGE_LIMIT_RADIANS,
1571                m_haveHeading,
1572                bulkUpdate);
1573        if (validated != null) {
1574          m_headingRadians = validated;
1575          m_haveHeading = true;
1576        }
1577      }
1578      case X_VELOCITY -> {
1579        Float validated =
1580            validateVelocity(Register.X_VELOCITY, value, VELOCITY_LIMIT_MM_PER_SECOND, bulkUpdate);
1581        if (validated != null) {
1582          m_xVelocityMillimetersPerSecond = validated;
1583        }
1584      }
1585      case Y_VELOCITY -> {
1586        Float validated =
1587            validateVelocity(Register.Y_VELOCITY, value, VELOCITY_LIMIT_MM_PER_SECOND, bulkUpdate);
1588        if (validated != null) {
1589          m_yVelocityMillimetersPerSecond = validated;
1590        }
1591      }
1592      case H_VELOCITY -> {
1593        Float validated =
1594            validateVelocity(
1595                Register.H_VELOCITY, value, HEADING_VELOCITY_LIMIT_RADIANS_PER_SECOND, bulkUpdate);
1596        if (validated != null) {
1597          m_headingVelocityRadiansPerSecond = validated;
1598        }
1599      }
1600      case MM_PER_TICK -> m_ticksPerMillimeter = value;
1601      case X_POD_OFFSET -> m_xPodOffsetMillimeters = value;
1602      case Y_POD_OFFSET -> m_yPodOffsetMillimeters = value;
1603      case YAW_SCALAR -> m_yawScalar = value;
1604      case QUATERNION_W -> m_quaternionW = value;
1605      case QUATERNION_X -> m_quaternionX = value;
1606      case QUATERNION_Y -> m_quaternionY = value;
1607      case QUATERNION_Z -> m_quaternionZ = value;
1608      case PITCH -> m_pitchRadians = value;
1609      case ROLL -> m_rollRadians = value;
1610      default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(register + " is not a float data register");
1611    }
1612  }
1613
1614  private boolean validateFinite(Register register, float value) {
1615    if (m_errorDetectionType == ErrorDetectionType.LOCAL_TEST && !Float.isFinite(value)) {
1616      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.NONFINITE_VALUE);
1617      return false;
1618    }
1619    return true;
1620  }
1621
1622  private Float validatePosition(
1623      Register register,
1624      float oldValue,
1625      float newValue,
1626      float changeLimit,
1627      boolean haveOldValue,
1628      boolean bulkUpdate) {
1629    if (m_errorDetectionType != ErrorDetectionType.LOCAL_TEST) {
1630      return newValue;
1631    }
1632    boolean missingBulkData = bulkUpdate && m_loopTimeMicroseconds <= 0;
1633    if (missingBulkData) {
1634      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.INVALID_LOOP_TIME);
1635      return null;
1636    }
1637    if (!Float.isFinite(newValue)) {
1638      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.NONFINITE_VALUE);
1639      return null;
1640    }
1641    if (haveOldValue && Math.abs(newValue - oldValue) > changeLimit) {
1642      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.CHANGE_TOO_LARGE);
1643      return null;
1644    }
1645    return newValue;
1646  }
1647
1648  private Float validateVelocity(
1649      Register register, float newValue, float magnitudeLimit, boolean bulkUpdate) {
1650    if (m_errorDetectionType != ErrorDetectionType.LOCAL_TEST) {
1651      return newValue;
1652    }
1653    boolean missingBulkData = bulkUpdate && m_loopTimeMicroseconds <= 0;
1654    if (missingBulkData) {
1655      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.INVALID_LOOP_TIME);
1656      return null;
1657    }
1658    if (!Float.isFinite(newValue)) {
1659      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.NONFINITE_VALUE);
1660      return null;
1661    }
1662    if (Math.abs(newValue) > magnitudeLimit) {
1663      recordFailure(register, FailureReason.VELOCITY_TOO_LARGE);
1664      return null;
1665    }
1666    return newValue;
1667  }
1668
1669  private void recordFailure(Register register, FailureReason reason) {
1670    m_badReadDetected = true;
1671    m_lastFailedRegister = register;
1672    m_lastFailureReason = reason;
1673    m_failureCount++;
1674    m_failureCounts[register.ordinal()]++;
1675  }
1676
1677  private void finishRead(boolean previousBadRead, boolean clearPreviousBadRead) {
1678    if (!m_badReadDetected && previousBadRead && !clearPreviousBadRead) {
1679      m_badReadDetected = true;
1680    }
1681  }
1682
1683  private static DeviceStatus decodeStatus(int status) {
1684    if ((status & DeviceStatus.CALIBRATING.m_mask) != 0) {
1685      return DeviceStatus.CALIBRATING;
1686    }
1687    boolean xPodDetected = (status & DeviceStatus.FAULT_X_POD_NOT_DETECTED.m_mask) == 0;
1688    boolean yPodDetected = (status & DeviceStatus.FAULT_Y_POD_NOT_DETECTED.m_mask) == 0;
1689    if (!xPodDetected && !yPodDetected) {
1690      return DeviceStatus.FAULT_NO_PODS_DETECTED;
1691    }
1692    if (!xPodDetected) {
1693      return DeviceStatus.FAULT_X_POD_NOT_DETECTED;
1694    }
1695    if (!yPodDetected) {
1696      return DeviceStatus.FAULT_Y_POD_NOT_DETECTED;
1697    }
1698    if ((status & DeviceStatus.FAULT_IMU_RUNAWAY.m_mask) != 0) {
1699      return DeviceStatus.FAULT_IMU_RUNAWAY;
1700    }
1701    if ((status & DeviceStatus.FAULT_BAD_READ.m_mask) != 0) {
1702      return DeviceStatus.FAULT_BAD_READ;
1703    }
1704    if ((status & DeviceStatus.READY.m_mask) != 0) {
1705      return DeviceStatus.READY;
1706    }
1707    return DeviceStatus.NOT_READY;
1708  }
1709
1710  private static byte[] encodeInt(int value) {
1711    return ByteBuffer.allocate(REGISTER_LENGTH)
1712        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
1713        .putInt(value)
1714        .array();
1715  }
1716
1717  private static byte[] encodeFloat(float value) {
1718    return ByteBuffer.allocate(REGISTER_LENGTH)
1719        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
1720        .putFloat(value)
1721        .array();
1722  }
1723
1724  private static int decodeInt(byte[] data, int offset) {
1725    return ByteBuffer.wrap(data, offset, REGISTER_LENGTH).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getInt();
1726  }
1727
1728  private static float decodeFloat(byte[] data, int offset) {
1729    return ByteBuffer.wrap(data, offset, REGISTER_LENGTH).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getFloat();
1730  }
1731
1732  private static boolean checkCrc(byte[] data, int dataLength) {
1733    return data.length > dataLength && computeCrc8(data, dataLength) == data[dataLength];
1734  }
1735
1736  private static byte computeCrc8(byte[] data, int length) {
1737    byte crc = CRC_INITIAL_VALUE;
1738    for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) {
1739      crc ^= data[index];
1740      for (int bit = 0; bit < 8; bit++) {
1741        if ((crc & 0x80) != 0) {
1742          crc = (byte) ((crc << 1) ^ CRC_POLYNOMIAL_VALUE);
1743        } else {
1744          crc <<= 1;
1745        }
1746      }
1747    }
1748    return crc;
1749  }
1750}
